newsitem.title: USA: ShopKo Q2 gross margin declines.
newsitem.headline: ShopKo Q2 gross margin declines.

text.p: ShopKo Stores Inc, which specializes in prescription and vision benefit management, said Tuesday its gross margin for the second quarter fell to 22.7 percent compared with 24.8 percent a year ago.

The gross margin decline reflected LIFO inventory charges of $800,000 this year compared with $200,000 a year ago. The margin also declined due to lower gross margins in the prescription benefit management business and to pressures in retail pharmacies as a result of increased managed care business.
Selling, general and administrative expenses for the quarter, however, were 17.7 percent of sales, down from 19.9 percent a year ago.
Earlier, Shopko reported earnigns for the second quarter ended September 7 of $0.12 a share, compared with $0.06 a year ago.

Consolidated sales for the quarter rose to $498.5 million compared with $418.2 million a year earlier. Consolidated comparable sales rose 14.9 percent, and retail comparable store sales increased 6.4 percent in the second quarter.
